summary: OffsetDateTime addition and subtraction passed UTC arithmetic results to replace_date_time, which interprets them as local time and subtracts the stored offset again. Consequently, even adding or subtracting zero changes the instant at nonzero offsets. The fix treats the result as UTC with assume_utc(), then restores the original offset without changing the instant. The fix-added regression test checks zero-duration arithmetic at +12:00:01. Both implementation corrections are reversed verbatim; no tests were run.
